suggested_requirements.text: The system shall allow users to browse and access computer system areas and objects.
The system shall allow users to select objects using various criteria including extension, attributes, size, and date.
The system shall allow users to access the create archive interface and extraction interface.
The system shall allow users to access computer system management tools including disk utilities and system benchmark.
The system shall allow users to perform secure file deletion.
The system shall allow users to perform byte-to-byte file comparison.
The system shall allow users to check files for duplicates and corruption.
The system shall allow users to split files and merge split volumes.
The system shall allow users to view file content in hexadecimal format.
The system shall allow users to extract contents of compressed archives.
The system shall allow users to create and update compressed archives.
The system shall allow users to append a timestamp to archive names.
The system shall support drag and drop of objects between the computer system and the application.
The system shall allow users to encrypt archives using a password and optional keyfile.
The system shall allow users to generate random passwords and keyfiles.
The system shall provide a graphical display of the progress of currently executed functions.
The system shall allow users to modify application settings including language, interface layout, and tool behavior.
The system shall require an x-86 compatible CPU.
The system shall prevent access to encrypted archives without the correct password and keyfile.
The system shall ensure no data remains in the storage area after a secure deletion procedure.
The system shall provide help messages in case of errors.
The system shall be usable by users without specific computer experience by providing manuals and tutorials.
